name: RELA proto-oncogene, NF-kB subunit

function.text: RELA encodes transcription factor p65. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and chromatin organization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to combined immunodeficiency due to RELA haploinsufficiency (autosomal dominant); autoinflammatory disease, familial, Behcet-like-3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Ependymoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
